$comment: One list row per recorded event (BasedHardware/omi#17281). The backend groups captures of one real-world event from different surfaces (desktop, pendant, phone) into a `capture_group`, identical on every member, only after confirming shared speech. Clients collapse the rows they have LOADED (paging offsets still count server rows): the representative is the member whose id equals the group's `primary_id` when it is loaded, otherwise the first loaded member in list order; every other loaded member of that group is hidden behind it. A member whose group has no other loaded member is shown as itself, so grouping can hide a duplicate but never a conversation. Rows without a group are never touched. `rows` is the loaded list in display order; `group` names a group from `groups`; `expected_ids` is the collapsed list in order.
